_comment: All coordinates are in world pixels. X increases left->right, Y increases top->bottom. Change values carefully because every wall uses min[x,y] (top-left) and max[x,y] (bottom-right).

walk_area._comment: Walk area is the playable rectangle. left/right/top/bottom set its bounds. edge_thickness is the thickness (in px) used by outer border wall pieces.

walls_comment: Each entry is one blocking AABB rectangle. min=[xMin,yMin], max=[xMax,yMax]. Increasing xMax widens right; decreasing xMin widens left; increasing yMax extends down; decreasing yMin extends up.

walls.comment: Outer left border wall (uses walk_area.left and edge thickness).
Outer right border - top segment; gap between this and next segment is a passage.
Outer right border - bottom segment; changing min.y changes where right-side passage starts.
Outer bottom border wall (Level 2 is lower, so this uses y=870/873).
